name: Note Lock (Casual Privacy)
description: A theme-matched client-side password screen for casual privacy ONLY. Not encryption or secure access control: note content may remain readable in page source, search, feeds and embeds. Passwords are stored in your garden configuration; never use a sensitive or reused password.
author: Kolten Bendickson

settings.name: Password for locked notes
settings.description: Used by notes with lock: true. Visible in this settings field and to anyone with access to the garden source repository. Use a unique passphrase.

settings.name: Per-note passwords (JSON)
settings.description: Optional overrides using published note URLs: {"/private-note/":"different passphrase"}. These notes are locked automatically. Keep the garden source repository private.
